moments.author: Britt McHenry
moments.quote: To get promoted and fired within 24 hours is impressive.
moments.why: Jemele Hill’s savage jab at McHenry’s rapid promotion‑then‑firing after a viral drink‑throwing sideline incident is lighting up X.

moments.author: Donald Trump
moments.quote: He’s no good, a TOTAL DISGRACE.
moments.why: Trump’s blistering post calling LeBron James a “TOTAL DISGRACE” for practicing a golf swing during the national anthem has gone viral.

moments.author: Sean Payton
moments.quote: Patience is going to be important.
moments.why: The clip of Payton giving a cheek‑kiss greeting to Charissa Thompson before the game has fans drawing Vrabel–Russini comparisons and going wild.
